purpose: Test whether the Qwen3.8 template's default xhigh thinking exhausts the 256-token tool-call budget before a named tool call can be emitted.
controlledDifferenceFromAttempt04: Only add chat_template_kwargs={enable_thinking:false} to the same named read_file/write_file requests and final none-mode request. Keep model, TP, context, KV, GPU_UTIL, DFlash2, fixture, sampling, seed and max_tokens unchanged.

chatTemplateEvidence.finding: When enable_thinking is undefined/true and reasoning_effort is omitted, the template injects xhigh instructions and begins assistant generation with <think>.

passCriteria: read_file named call has an ID and requests exactly source.txt
write_file named call has an ID, requests exactly result.txt, and carries the fixture bytes
final none-mode completion is non-empty and contains no tool call
result bytes equal fixture; only response metadata is saved
service is stopped, logs are redacted mode 0600, and port 18142 is free
interpretationLimit: A pass shows this named tool loop works with thinking disabled; it does not prove auto selection with default reasoning. Tool-Eval and adoption remain blocked pending a real auto-mode test.
failurePolicy: One run only, no automatic retry and no Tool-Eval. Analyze failure before planning another change.
